/* cppi::066124caa89b153b9cb1d2b320ccf35d07cc85f3d6e9545bad8c8a9fe92c38b4 */
with 
	Trust AS
	  (
	    SELECT DISTINCT
	      t.party_name,
	      t.abcp_limit,
	      t.abcp_sponsor_id,
	      t.rtg_sp_st,
	      t.rtg_moody_st,
	      t.rtg_dbrs_st,
	      t.rtg_fitch_st,
		  t.rtg_final,
	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN coalesce(f.credit_exposure, 0) ELSE 0 END ) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.party_name ) AS ce_by_trust
	    FROM	      
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity t,
	      radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure f,
		  radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
	    WHERE
	      t.business_date = '2025-06-16'
	      and t.business_date = f.business_date 
	      and t.business_date = pos.business_date 
	      AND t.abcp_sponsor_id IS NOT NULL
	      AND f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = t.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		  AND f.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	  )
	SELECT DISTINCT
	  sponsor.party_name as sponsor_party_name,
	  trust.party_name as trust_party_name,
	  coalesce(trust.abcp_limit / 1000000, 0) AS abcp_limit,
	  coalesce(trust.rtg_sp_st, '-') AS rtg_sp_st,
	  coalesce(trust.rtg_moody_st, '-') AS rtg_moody_st,
	  coalesce(trust.rtg_dbrs_st, '-') AS rtg_dbrs_st,
	  coalesce(trust.rtg_fitch_st, '-') AS rtg_fitch_st,
	  coalesce(trust.rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
	  trust.ce_by_trust / 1000000 AS ce_by_trust
	FROM
	  radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sponsor,
	  Trust trust
	WHERE
	  sponsor.business_date = '2025-06-16'
	  AND trust.abcp_sponsor_id = sponsor.cppib_party_id    
    ORDER BY
	  sponsor.party_name,
	  trust.party_name

/* cppi::04cbfcc1dd4d50d95b6770d5ab4f81c2aaf7afea6fb8d99d11da88f3676589c8 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-17')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-17')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",

WITH latest_meta_run_date AS (

    FROM df_trusted_prod.markit_credit_index_component
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
),

    SELECT MAX(file_date) AS max_file_date
    FROM market.markit_credit_index
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
)
SELECT
    idx.index_family,
    idx.index_name,
    idx.annex_date,
    idx.index_series,
    idx.index_version,
    idx.index_factor,
    comp.index_clip,
    comp.component_ref_entity_ticker,

    comp.component_ref_entity_red,
    comp.component_ref_entity_record_date,

    comp.component_coupon,
    evt.red_entity_code,
    evt.reference_entity,
    evt.ticker,
    evt.cerrd AS event_determination_date,
    evt.corporateaction_event_date,
    evt.default_date,
    evt.type,
    evt.event_type,

    evt.tier_name,

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 13:08:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 00 and 01
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 00:16:25'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime

		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 21:51:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight b981389f-df33-4195-8ee0-df5a0491b04c */
SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'IPN_S'
					--, 'SAP_S'
				)
				and node_id = '2'
			)
			or
			(	/* TOTAL FUND */
				dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd'

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'

			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [

			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	from (

	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id

			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency

		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date

), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc

			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update

					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'

					/* SUPP POOL */

			or

				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

	cross join unnest (

		/* VALUE */

			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value

	inner join (

		select

			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency

		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date

), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll

					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'

					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'IPN_S'

				and node_id = '2'

			or
			(	/* TOTAL FUND */
				dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[

), inv_select_dept_tfm as (

		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name

), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'

				else metric_friendly_name

		, metric

		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select

				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'

					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'

				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'

			, case

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end

					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'

					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)'

					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

	cross join unnest(

), inv_select_dept_tfm as (

		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name

), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)

			, case

						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select

		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name

		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value

), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case

						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )

					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		, 'Local' as currency

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'

		]
		/* VALUE */

			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	from (

	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id

			, currency
			, period

			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from

		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency

		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date

), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'

			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */

			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	from (

	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id

			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency

		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
